description: Look up direct and upstream Czech VR owners for a company by real active shareholding roles (spolecnik/akcionar) and company-to-company member_ico edges. Free anonymous tool. Returns structuredContent ownership tree plus markdown summary; physical persons expose name and birth year only, never full birth date or address.

max_depth.description: Max company-owner recursion depth through member_ico (default 5, hard cap 5).

name: get_owners
